quick: Start levodopa 50 mg + benserazide 12.5 mg three to four times daily; increase every 3 to 7 days
Sudden sleep onset; do not stop abruptly
summary: Benserazide blocks peripheral conversion of levodopa to dopamine, so more levodopa reaches the brain and nausea is reduced. It is given only with levodopa (levodopa:benserazide 4:1).
indications: Restless legs syndrome (with levodopa, some regions)

dosage.d: Start levodopa 50 mg + benserazide 12.5 mg three to four times daily; increase every 3 to 7 days
dosage.n: Usual maintenance levodopa 400 to 800 mg/day in divided doses

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Inhibits aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase outside the CNS; does not cross the blood-brain barrier.

absolute: Patients under 25 years (skeletal development, per product information)
Decompensated endocrine, renal, hepatic or cardiac disease

counsel: Do not drive if sudden sleepiness occurs
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
